newsitem.title: USA: Buckle October same store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Buckle October same store sales rise.

text.p: Buckle Inc said Thursday same store sales for the four-week period ended November 2 were up 11.5 percent from the same perior a year ago.
Total sales for that period rose 21.5 percent to $14.3 million from $11.8 million in the corresponding four-week period of 1995.

Net sales year-to-date, for the 39 weeks ended November increased 23.4 percent to $144.3 million from $116.9 million for the corresponding 39 weeks in the prior year. Comparable store sales year-to-date were up 13.7 percent from sales in the same 39-week period of the previous year.
